EDR camera-offset diagnostics

Enter Curiosity image IDs separated by commas or new lines. The tool reloads their NASA raw-image records, compares all geometry-relevant fields, and retains the complete source records in an exportable JSON report. It accepts ?correct=id1,id2&problematic=id3,id4.

The report compares product family, Sol/site/drive, timestamps, camera-model components, vectors, positions, subframe geometry, and extended metadata. It does not modify the panorama.
